aboutText: Home Fix Group Handyman has been serving Niddrie and Melbourne's western suburbs for many years. Our friendly, skilled workers are experienced professionals who take pride in tidy, quality workmanship. We are known for being knowledgeable, following through on requests, and making sure every job is completed to the highest standard. Contact us today for reliable handyman services.
